name: accumulate_unused_fallback
old:
| .replacement (some primary) _ :: rest, summary =>
      accumulate rest (combine summary (scan primary))
new:
| .replacement (some primary) fallback :: rest, summary =>
      let extra := match fallback with
        | none => some emptyFlags
        | some tokens => scan tokens
      accumulate rest (combine summary (combine (scan primary) extra))
